items.summary: Recommendation: maintain financial containment. Reject new spend, forecasts, commitments, monetization expansion, and unsupported revenue claims. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The aggregate row is not site-attributable; site-attributed commission is $0, which does not prove zero site performance. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable because revenue and cost periods do not align; AI-cost records conflict ($881.36 across 4,832 calls for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27 versus retained $973.35 across 5,439 calls); infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, approved-budget, experiment-cost, and learning-outcome records are absent or incomplete. Continue only existing period-aligned attribution and cost reconciliation. Retain proposed product work as declined for this cycle, not as an approved proposal or queue entry.

CFO review: the proposed fleet execution control-plane capability should not be retained as a proposal this cycle. Its operational evidence is credible—34% approved-proposal execution, 187 approved items unexecuted, 47 failure follow-ups open, 28 improvements awaiting measurement, and 2 proven outcomes—but those figures do not establish financial return or justify new spend. Preserve only as an uncommitted future concept; continue existing reconciliation and containment work.

Continue existing period-aligned attribution and cost reconciliation only. Do not treat impressions, rankings, clicks, sessions, conversions, ordered items, performance scores, or AI usage as financial returns. Preserve aggregate commission as unattributed and retain unknown margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, budget capacity, and causal lift.
